title: How Weather Works
summary: Why the wind blows, how clouds make rain and what a monsoon is.

steps.title: Weather vs climate
sentences: Weather is what the air is like today: sunny, rainy, windy or hot.
Climate is the usual weather of a place over many years.
So a rainy day in Chennai is weather, but hot summers are part of its climate.

steps.title: Warm air rises
sentences: The Sun warms the ground, and the ground warms the air above it.
Warm air is lighter, so it rises, and cooler air rushes in to take its place.
That moving air is the wind.

steps.title: Clouds and rain
sentences: As warm, moist air rises it cools, and the water vapour turns into tiny drops that make clouds.
When the drops grow heavy enough, they fall as rain.
Tall dark clouds can also build up electric charge, which gives us lightning and thunder.

steps.title: The monsoon
sentences: In summer the land of India heats up faster than the sea.
Warm air over land rises and pulls in wet winds from the ocean, and this gives us the southwest monsoon rains.
In winter the wind direction reverses, and Tamil Nadu gets much of its rain from the northeast monsoon.

facts: Lightning is about five times hotter than the surface of the Sun.
You can estimate how far a storm is by counting the seconds between lightning and thunder, and dividing by three to get kilometres.
The word monsoon comes from an Arabic word meaning season.

options: Chennai is usually hot and humid
quiz.why: Climate is the usual weather over many years.
Wind is air moving from cooler, higher-pressure places toward warmer, lower-pressure places.

quiz.q: Tamil Nadu gets much of its rain from which monsoon?
quiz.why: Most of Tamil Nadu's rain arrives with the northeast monsoon from October to December.

notes: Rain timing differs from year to year; the monsoon months given are the usual pattern.
